findings.en_sentence: It has been debated whether P. cyrtocristatus represents a female of P. walkeri or P. tubicen, though some studies argue against this due to differences in age and anatomy.
findings.es_sentence: Se ha debatido si P. cyrtocristatus representa una hembra de P. walkeri o de P. tubicen, aunque algunos estudios argumentan en contra debido a diferencias de edad y anatomía.
findings.problem: Source gives no 'studies arguing against due to anatomy'; it only notes P. tubicen lived about a million years later, and the crest/size features were the basis FOR the female idea.
findings.correct: It has often been speculated that P. cyrtocristatus was a female of P. walkeri or P. tubicen, although P. tubicen lived about a million years later.

findings.en_sentence: The crest is believed to have served multiple purposes, including sexual attraction, communication during danger, and thermoregulation.
findings.es_sentence: Se cree que la cresta cumplió múltiples funciones, como la atracción sexual, la comunicación ante peligros y la regulación térmica.
findings.problem: Narrows and distorts the accepted functions: the display role is species/sex recognition (not just sexual attraction) and sound was for communication in general, not 'during danger' (a garbled eswiki phrase).
findings.correct: visual display for recognising species and sex, sound for communication, and thermoregulation

findings.en_sentence: The most prominent theory suggests the crest acted as a natural resonator for sound production.
findings.es_sentence: La teoría más aceptada sugiere que la cresta actuaba como un resonador natural para la producción de sonidos.
findings.problem: ES 'más aceptada' overstates the source ('más sobresaliente'); enwiki says it is unclear which function was most significant.
findings.correct: Una de las hipótesis más destacadas es que la cresta actuaba como resonador natural para producir sonidos.

findings.en_sentence: The animal could walk on two or four legs, likely preferring to forage quadrupedally but running bipedally.
findings.es_sentence: El animal podía caminar sobre dos o cuatro patas, probablemente prefiriendo alimentarse en cuadrúpeda pero correr en bípeda.
findings.problem: 'en cuadrúpeda' / 'en bípeda' is ungrammatical, and 'prefiriendo ... pero correr' mixes verb forms.
findings.correct: El animal podía caminar sobre dos o cuatro patas; probablemente prefería alimentarse a cuatro patas, pero corría sobre dos.

findings.en_sentence: The plateau where it lived was an ancient floodplain with large channels, wetland swamps, ponds, and lakes, bordered by highlands.
findings.es_sentence: La meseta donde habitaba era una antigua llanura aluvial con grandes canales, pantanos húmedos, charcas y lagos, bordeada por tierras altas.
findings.problem: 'The plateau' is never introduced: the source refers to the Kaiparowits Plateau / Kaiparowits Formation of Utah, which the page never names.
findings.correct: In the Kaiparowits Formation of Utah, the area where it lived was an ancient floodplain...

findings.en_sentence: When the species existed, the Fruitland Formation was a swampy lowland area close to the shore of the Cretaceous Interior Seaway.
findings.es_sentence: Cuando existió la especie, la Formación Fruitland era una zona baja y pantanosa cercana a la costa del Mar Interior del Cretácico.
findings.problem: 'The species' is undefined; the page never says which species (P. cyrtocristatus, New Mexico) comes from the Fruitland Formation.
findings.correct: When P. cyrtocristatus lived, the Fruitland Formation of New Mexico was...

findings.en_sentence: Parasaurolophus was quickly assigned to the hadrosaurid subfamily Lambeosaurinae, whereas Saurolophus is considered a Hadrosaurinae.
findings.es_sentence: Parasaurolophus fue rápidamente incluido en la subfamilia Lambeosaurinae de los hadrosáuridos, mientras que Saurolophus se considera un hadrosáurino.
findings.problem: EN repeats the previous sentence almost verbatim (lambeosaurine, distinct from hadrosaurine Saurolophus); 'quickly' has no antecedent because the page never says it was first linked to Saurolophus.
findings.correct: Keep one sentence: Although named for a supposed link to Saurolophus, it was soon reassessed as a lambeosaurine hadrosaurid.

findings.en_sentence: It is classified as a member of the lambeosaurine subfamily within the hadrosaurids, distinct from the hadrosaurine Saurolophus.
findings.es_sentence: Parasaurolophus fue rápidamente incluido en la subfamilia Lambeosaurinae de los hadrosáuridos, mientras que Saurolophus se considera un hadrosáurino.
findings.problem: Saurolophus is now placed in Saurolophinae (Prieto-Márquez 2010), the subfamily named after it; 'hadrosaurine' in this sense is the older usage.

findings.es_sentence: Parasaurolophus fue rápidamente incluido en la subfamilia Lambeosaurinae de los hadrosáuridos, mientras que Saurolophus se considera un hadrosáurino.
findings.problem: 'hadrosáurino' is misaccented; the Spanish form is llana, like 'lambeosaurino'.

findings.en_sentence: Hundreds of teeth were arranged in columns and replaced as they wore down.
findings.es_sentence: Cientos de dientes se disponían en columnas y se sustituían conforme se desgastaban.
findings.problem: Repeats the previous sentence (hundreds of teeth in dental batteries, continuously replaced).

findings.en_sentence: As a large herbivore, it possessed a skull capable of a grinding motion similar to chewing.
findings.es_sentence: Como gran herbívoro, poseía un cráneo capaz de un movimiento de trituración similar a la masticación.
findings.problem: Implies the chewing-like skull follows from being a large herbivore; source says 'as a hadrosaurid' (a hadrosaurid trait, which many large herbivores lacked).
findings.correct: Like other hadrosaurids, it had a skull that allowed a grinding motion analogous to chewing.

findings.en_sentence: A juvenile individual, nicknamed Joe and numbered RAM 14000, was formally described in 2013.
findings.es_sentence: Un individuo juvenil, apodado Joe y numerado RAM 14000, fue descrito formalmente en 2013.
findings.problem: Joe is already introduced in the 'What we know' section and is reintroduced here as new.
findings.correct: The juvenile Joe (RAM 14000), from the Kaiparowits Formation of Utah, was described in 2013.

findings.en_sentence: The genus belongs to the parent group Parasaurolophini.
findings.problem: 'Parent group' is database jargon and Parasaurolophini is never explained (tribe shared with Charonosaurus); sentence also absent in ES.
findings.correct: Together with its close relative Charonosaurus, it may form the tribe Parasaurolophini.

findings.en_sentence: This large plant-eating dinosaur grew to a length exceeding 9 meters and a mass surpassing 5 metric tons.
findings.es_sentence: Este gran herbívoro alcanzó una longitud superior a 9 metros y una masa que superaba las 5 toneladas métricas.
findings.problem: 'toneladas métricas' is a calque of 'metric tons'; in Spanish 'toneladas' already means 1000 kg.

findings.en_sentence: In the Dinosaur Park Formation, its habitat was a low-relief area of rivers and floodplains that became swampy and influenced by marine conditions.
findings.es_sentence: En la Formación Dinosaur Park, su hábitat era una zona de baja pendiente de ríos y llanuras aluviales que se convirtieron en pantanos y estuvieron influenciadas por condiciones marinas.
findings.problem: Source says the setting became MORE swampy and marine-influenced over time; 'se convirtieron en pantanos' says the rivers turned into swamps (EN also drops 'over time').
findings.correct: ...de relieve bajo, con ríos y llanuras aluviales, que con el tiempo se volvió más pantanosa y con mayor influencia marina.
